modules.name: PM ทรัพย์สิน IT (Preventive Maintenance)
modules.key_workflow: Template -> Plan -> generate Runs -> perform with GLPI/Agent-assisted data entry -> auto-create monitor/printer assets + CMDB link

modules.name: Donation & Disposal (จำหน่าย/บริจาค)
Delivery, Licenses, Contracts
modules.notable: delivery.ts exposes a public token-based confirmation endpoint with no authentication

modules.name: PM SW/Hub Room & Floor Plan
modules.notable: parallel PM system for network cabinets, independent of the main Asset-based PM system; FloorPlan pins are people/seats, devices follow via ownerName matching; floorplan.ts is the one route file using router.use(authenticate) file-wide instead of per-route, leaving 6 read endpoints role-open (masked in practice by frontend route guard)

modules.name: Dashboard & Reports
modules.notable: 7 dashboard widget components exist but are never imported anywhere (dead code); ReportBorrowPage.tsx has a real bug reading a field the backend never sends

modules.name: Admin & Settings
modules.notable: SettingsPage.tsx has 14 non-sequential tabs; two parallel/unrelated backup systems coexist (full pg_dump vs JSON asset export); several backend endpoints have no calling UI at all

modules.name: Asset Registry Core
modules.notable: dual-write pattern: legacy free-text columns (ownerName, departmentId, vendor, location, company) alongside newer FK relations (assignedToUserId, departmentRefId, vendorRefId, locationRefId), reconciled by resolver functions on every write; which *Detail table an asset uses is decided by free-text type-keyword matching, decoupled from categoryId; several AssetFormPage.tsx fields have no matching DB column and are silently dropped on save

notable_patterns: Category-driven polymorphic detail tables: one Asset row + one of 9 possible *Detail 1:1 tables depending on type (ComputerDetail, PhoneDetail, MonitorDetail, DeviceDetail, NetworkDeviceDetail, RackDetail, PrinterDetail, CableDetail, ConsumableDetail)

Dual-write migration in progress: legacy string columns co-exist with newer FK relations on Asset (ownerName/assignedToUserId, departmentId/departmentRefId, vendor/vendorRefId, location/locationRefId)
Supervisor-approval borrow workflow added via AppUser.managerId self-relation + BorrowRequestStatus.PendingSupervisor + ApprovalStage enum (migrations 20260826150000 / 20260826150500)
SystemSetting is the only model with no @@map (uses PascalCase table name literally)

security.session_mechanism: JWT in httpOnly cookie 'assethub_session' (not localStorage) + Bearer header fallback for non-browser clients

rate_limiting.login: configurable via LOGIN_RATE_LIMIT_MAX, deliberately under AD lockout threshold

security.csrf_protection: none dedicated — relies on SameSite=Lax cookie + strict CORS origin allow-list (flagged as unverified-adequacy gap)
notable_findings: startDailySummaryJob() in jobs/proactiveSummary.ts appears to be dead code — defined but never called
ALLOW_DEV_AUTH_BYPASS dev-only auth bypass exists, gated behind non-production env check
app.ts writes security headers by hand instead of using helmet; no CSP header set

known_issues_found_during_documentation.title: MonitorDetail upsert can null out screenSize/ports/hasSpeaker
known_issues_found_during_documentation.description: In pm.ts processDeviceAnswers(), if a device object carries any one of screenSize/ports/hasSpeaker, all three get upserted together — the two not supplied get written as null, overwriting previously-recorded values. Affects both the GLPI sync path and (avoided-but-not-fixed) the newly added Agent monitor path.
known_issues_found_during_documentation.status: known, not fixed — flagged as a spawn_task chip for the user

known_issues_found_during_documentation.title: assets.ts previously required ownerName on every update
known_issues_found_during_documentation.description: validateAssetData() unconditionally required a non-empty ownerName even for assets that legitimately have no current holder (e.g. sitting in IT storage). Fixed during this session by removing the requirement; confirmed still in place by the Assets Core research pass.

known_issues_found_during_documentation.title: ReportBorrowPage.tsx reads a field the backend never sends
known_issues_found_during_documentation.description: Line 232 reads summary.activeCheckedOut; the backend only ever returns activeItems. The 'กำลังยืม' (currently borrowed) stat card on the borrow report always shows 0.
known_issues_found_during_documentation.status: known, not fixed — flagged as a spawn_task chip for the user

known_issues_found_during_documentation.title: AssetFormPage.tsx collects several fields with no matching DB column
known_issues_found_during_documentation.description: Phone color, network portSpeed/isManaged, printer paperSizes/cartridgeModel, AV device lumens/lampHours/fps, rack vaCapacity/wattCapacity are all captured in the form UI but silently dropped on save since no Prisma column exists for them. Conversely several real columns (mdmEnrolled, networkType, locationRack, poeSupport, isColor, networkReady, duplexSupport, deviceType, powerSource, rgbSupport) have no form input at all.
known_issues_found_during_documentation.status: known, not fixed, not yet flagged as a task

known_issues_found_during_documentation.title: VIEWER role can open report pages the backend blocks
known_issues_found_during_documentation.description: VIEWER passes the React Router role guard for /reports/borrow, /reports/pm, /reports/maintenance, but the backend endpoints those pages actually call (/borrow/history, parts of /pm/runs, /pm/procurement-report, /maintenance/report/all) are IT_ADMIN/SUPERADMIN-only — VIEWER opens the page and then hits 403s loading data.
known_issues_found_during_documentation.status: known, not fixed, not yet flagged as a task
